policy.introductionDate: Store YYYY-MM-DD. Small regional rollout differences are tolerated; when credible sources disagree, use the majority date rather than marking unresolved solely for a minor date discrepancy.
policy.introductionYear: Derived from introductionDate and not stored.
policy.testOnlyMachines: Exclude explicit test-only machine IDs from production backfill.
policy.gameTypeRule: Use A_AT/A_ART only when an actual real bonus coexists with AT/ART. Pseudo-bonus-only machines remain AT even if presented as A-type-like. Machines centered on real bonus plus RT remain A_TYPE because the canonical taxonomy does not currently define A_RT.

notes: All completed batches 01-17 have explicit checkpoint files for interruption-resistant recovery.
Batch 17 resolved 10/10 production machines with no unresolved values.
SMART_SLOT/MEDAL is determined from source evidence, not machine ID prefix alone.
Introduction dates use majority/credible-source resolution for minor regional rollout differences.
Batch 17 contains three SMART_SLOT / BT machines (EVA Promise Door, Isekai Quartet BT, Tobe Harem Ace) and seven MEDAL / A_TYPE Juggler machines.
